VERIFIED: Session-level deduplication via prefetchedUrls Set in mediaPrefetch.ts (line 20) and preloadedIds Set in cloudinaryVideo.ts (line 187)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified Video Performance Phase 2 implementation. Key verification points: (1) GET /api/featured/config returns valid featuredWorkoutIds array with 24-char ObjectId strings.
